### AI first review (advisory): no blocker found

This review covers the full diff at `b4c090f3e4`. It read the code and did not run it.

I checked that streaming fallbacks for reasoning content and tool\-call arguments align with the non\-streaming path\, and that SSE error chunks are correctly caught to report failures instead of truncations\. All added test cases are complete and valid\.

<sub>A maintainer makes the merge decision. This review never approves the pull request.</sub>

@pcbeingused333 thanks for this proposal! The error-handling improvement is definitely good value.

To move on, can you please split this PR:

Keep: the handling of data: {"error": ...} chunks in the stream. This is a clear fix. Please keep it in this PR with its test, and remove the rest.
Leave out: the reasoning_content and tool-call fallback for streaming. We will take care of this part ourselves.

Why: the fallback copies what the non-streaming path on main already does, and we think that behavior is wrong in the first place. If content is empty and reasoning_content is not, we cannot tell if the server put the answer in the wrong field, or if the model only reasoned and never answered (for example, it hit max_tokens). In the second case the chain-of-thought ends up in the document as page content. Also, the generation stoppers only look at content, so with this fallback they never fire on reasoning-only output. That defeats the purpose of the streaming path.

Fixing this properly needs a redesign of how we read the API response fields (content, reasoning_content, tool_calls). It will change the non-streaming path on main too, so we prefer to do it in one place instead of extending the current behavior.

Thanks.

review_comments.body: I am not sure we want the reasoning or tool-call in the text. It would be cleaner to have dedicated fields for those in the return object and assign them.
this is no longer part of the PR.
